title: Maintenance and Ingest Idempotence
limitations: D1 remains shim-validated only; no remote D1 or workerd run.
Idempotence is id-based, not concurrency-safe; the losing racer lands on the append-only trigger.
No lifecycle-transition record type: state, reviewStatus, status and availability are immutable in place.
Mapping review workflow not implemented; reviewStatus is set at insert.
Support verification remains the lexical proxy, not entailment.
No real corpus or counsel determination.
